life One story · v8
v8 · Your life, as one story

The pictures stop being stock. They become one story.

The Pulse is back to the dot field you liked. Every image is now a frame from one continuous story about one person, the same face, the same warm light, the same orange thread, moving from a low morning to their own front door. For v1 the cast is generic and diverse: different people across the frames.

01 · Pulse, restored

The dot field is back.

Exactly as it was in v5: drag across the field, the dots swell around your finger, and the word and colour follow you. Mesh gradients are out of the mood check-in for good. Once set, today's picture follows your mood.

02 · One story

Four frames. One journey.

Each image is a moment in the same life (for v1, a mixed cast), so they feel connected wherever they appear: the soft one on a low day, the clear one on a good day, the energetic one when you're driven, and the glimpse of where it's all going.

Same lifeEvery frame is a moment in one person's day, never a random stock scene.
Same lightOne warm golden daylight grade and the same 35mm eye-level camera in every frame.
The orange threadThey always wear something ember-orange, the app's one signal colour, so every frame ties back to life.
Same placesThe flat, the desk, the river, the front door. Places come back, so the story builds.
03 · Imagery in the app

Generic for v1.

v1 ships with a diverse mixed cast: each moment shows a different person, so every kind of person is seen across the app. "Pictures that look like you" is parked behind a flag until every scene exists for a wide range of looks and has been tested with real people (DESIGN.md §44).

04 · Motion, the Apple way, on iOS and Android

It's not the effects. It's how things move.

Apple's apps feel expensive because of five habits: springs instead of timed curves, motion you can grab and throw, things that grow out of what you tapped, lists that settle in one after another, and numbers that roll. All five work the same on iOS and Android with Reanimated 4 and Gesture Handler, which are already in the app. Try each one below.

EffectiOSAndroid
Springs, gestures, shared transitions, staggerReanimated 4 · Gesture HandlerSame code, same feel
Icons that animateSF Symbols (expo-symbols)Material Symbols, animated with Reanimated
Particles, grain, glowSkiaSkia (identical)
Illustrated momentsRiveRive (identical)
Live progress outside the appLive Activities · Dynamic IslandOngoing notification with progress + Glance widget
HapticsTaptic Engine (expo-haptics)Vibration effects (expo-haptics)
05 · Rules for the builder

How to do this respectfully.

Ask, never guessThe look is chosen by the user in onboarding or Settings. Never infer it from a name, photo, voice or location.
Optional, with a real alternative"Places, not people" and "Mix it up" are first-class choices, shown with equal weight. Skipping is the default.
Look, not labelsAsk about appearance (skin tone, how you present, age range), not ethnic categories. It's less invasive and maps directly to the pictures.
Same scenes for everyoneScenes, homes, jobs and outcomes never vary by appearance. Only the person in the frame does.
Private by defaultStored on the device only, used for nothing but choosing pictures, never sent to analytics. Under UK GDPR this is special-category-adjacent data, so get explicit consent.
Easy to changeSettings → Pictures lets you change or clear it at any time, and the images update straight away.
